summary: MLS Compass Iteration 3 fully tested. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py covering (a) POST/PUT /api/quotes with year_level ('2nd Year' / empty / update to '3rd Year'), (b) POST /api/quotes/{id}/feature — verified auth required (401 without X-Admin-Pin), only-one-featured invariant (pinning a second quote unsets the first), 404 for non-existent id, (c) POST /api/quotes/unfeature — auth required, clears all is_featured flags, (d) Announcements category CRUD (Academic/Event/Reminder create+update+list), (e) GET /api/settings.pulse_sheet_url contains '/pubhtml'. Frontend (Playwright on preview URL): Home shows 4 filter chips (ann-filter-all/academic/event/reminder), clicking Academic filters (0 in seed) and All restores 1 seeded announcement with matching ann-category-{id} badge. Admin login OK, Contributions tab has contribution-year-select and successfully published a 2nd Year quote via UI. Admin Quotes tab shows 6 feature-quote-{id} buttons; pinning first → 'Featured on Ask MLS' label appears exactly once; pinning second → still exactly one featured label (previous unpinned). Ask MLS /ask shows featured-quote hero with attribution and year_level pill; year_level pills present on cards (2 rendered); featured quote is filtered out of the lower list (no duplicate). Support page pulse-sheet-iframe src contains '/pubhtml' (the published embed URL). Admin Announcements tab has new-ann-category select with all 3 options visible.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: feature_quote does two DB operations (update_many + find_one_and_update) without a transaction — acceptable for single-admin usage but concurrent pins could theoretically leave two docs featured briefly. Low priority.
server.py: still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown (carryover from iter2). Migrate to lifespan handlers.
Admin.jsx now ~900+ lines with 5 managers — consider splitting each manager into its own file for maintainability.
Quote model uses free-form string for year_level ('' | '2nd Year' | '3rd Year' | '4th Year'). Consider Literal / Enum for stronger validation, otherwise arbitrary strings can be persisted via API.
Announcement.category also free-form string with default 'Reminder' — same suggestion (Literal enum).
seed_data_creation: No new seed added. Test artifacts (2nd Year quote via UI, TEST_iter3_* backend fixtures, temporary featured pin) were cleaned up via API teardown / requests.delete. Post-run state: no quote is_featured=true; 6 seed quotes + 1 seed announcement remain; settings unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter3 features working. Backend tests split into backend_test.py (iter1/2 regression) and test_iteration3.py (new). Both run in parallel via pytest-xdist. Radix Select 'none' sentinel confirmed working from UI. No is_featured quote is currently pinned post-cleanup; pin one via Admin Quotes tab or POST /api/quotes/{id}/feature to test the hero on /ask.
